Our Story · Est. 1984

Four Decades of
Trust & Tradition.

What started in 1984 as a small family-run halal butcher in Woking has grown into something the whole community calls their own. Khans Imperial SuperStore has served generation after generation — and we still know most of our customers by name.

Every cut of meat is prepared in-house by butchers who have spent decades at the block. Our fruit and vegetables arrive fresh every morning — never sitting on a shelf longer than they need to.

We believe a great grocer should feel like a neighbour. Somewhere you can ask questions, trust what you're buying, and take home something your family will love.

"Quality You Deserve, Trust We Deliver — since 1984."

Our Journey
From a Single Stall to an Imperial Store
1984
The Beginning

Khans opens its doors as a small halal butcher in Woking, serving the local community with fresh, affordable cuts. The commitment from day one: quality you can count on, every single time.

1990s
Growing the Community

Word spread quickly. Khans became the go-to halal butcher for families across Woking and surrounding areas — fresh lamb, chicken and beef prepared in-house every morning without fail.

2000s
Expanding the Range

Fresh fruit, vegetables, groceries, bakery and frozen foods were added — making Khans a true one-stop shop for the whole family and earning the SuperStore name.

Today
Khans Imperial SuperStore

Four decades on, still family-run, still cutting fresh every morning. Now available to order by phone too — same care, same trust, even faster for you.

What We Stand For
Our Values
🕌
Halal. Always.

Every product we sell is halal. No mixed stock, no exceptions. We exist to serve our community with complete integrity — that has never changed since 1984.

🌅
Fresh Every Morning

Our butchers are in before sunrise. What you buy today was prepared today. That's not a slogan — it's how we have worked every single day for 40 years.

🤝
Family & Community

We've served Woking families for 40 years. We know your name, your preferences, the cuts your family loves. That personal touch is something no supermarket can replicate.
